plugins.name: Lensetek Agent Web Workspace
plugins.author: Lensetek
plugins.description: Modern light-first responsive Web IDE & Agent Workspace (Antigravity/Codex style) with real file read/write/edit, tool execution cards, and approval prompts.
plugins.description_id: Web IDE & Agent Workspace modern responsif (gaya Antigravity/Codex, light-mode default) dengan akses baca/tulis/edit file nyata, kartu eksekusi tool, dan persetujuan aman.
plugins.description_cn: 现代响应式 Web IDE 与智能体工作区（默认浅色模式），支持真实项目文件读写编辑、工具执行卡片和权限审批。

plugins.name: Playwright Dynamic Web Research
plugins.author: Lensetek
plugins.description: Headless Chromium browser scraper with Smart Markdown Cleaner optimized for 3B edge models.
plugins.description_id: Scraper web dinamis berbasis headless Chromium dengan pembersih teks Markdown optimal untuk model 3B.
plugins.description_cn: 基于无头 Chromium 的动态网页抓取工具，内置专为 3B 端侧模型优化的 Markdown 清理器。

plugins.name: Guided Study Tutor & Mindmap
plugins.author: Lensetek
plugins.description: Structured study tutor with PDF/file ingestion into SQLite, chapter progress tracking, active recall quizzes, flashcards, and interactive SVG mindmap viewer.
plugins.description_id: Mode tutor belajar terstruktur dengan ingest PDF/berkas ke SQLite, pelacakan progres bab, kuis active recall, flashcard, dan tampilan mindmap SVG interaktif.
plugins.description_cn: 结构化学习导师插件：支持将 PDF/文档导入 SQLite、章节进度追踪、主动回忆测验、抽认卡及交互式 SVG 思维导图。

plugins.name: Double-Entry Accounting & Ledger
plugins.author: Lensetek
plugins.description: Local SQLite double-entry bookkeeping with Chart of Accounts, General & Special Journals, General Ledger, Trial Balance, Income Statement, and Balance Sheet.
plugins.description_id: Pembukuan akuntansi double-entry berbasis SQLite lokal dengan Bagan Akun (CoA), Jurnal Umum & Khusus, Buku Besar, Neraca Saldo, Laba Rugi, dan Neraca.
plugins.description_cn: 基于本地 SQLite 的复式记账会计插件：支持会计科目表、通用/特种日记账、总分类账、试算平衡表、损益表与资产负债表。

plugins.name: IoT Studio & Hardware Workbench
plugins.author: Lensetek
plugins.description: Arduino/ESP32 code editor with real pyserial COM port monitor, arduino-cli compile/upload terminal, and live interactive SVG wiring & pin conflict analyzer.
plugins.description_id: Editor kode Arduino/ESP32 dengan monitor port COM nyata (pyserial), terminal compile/upload (arduino-cli), serta diagram wiring SVG interaktif & pemeriksa konflik pin.
plugins.description_cn: Arduino/ESP32 物联网工作台：支持真实串口监视器 (pyserial)、arduino-cli 编译烧录终端以及交互式 SVG 接线图与引脚冲突检测。

plugins.name: Trading Desk & Market Analytics
plugins.author: Lensetek
plugins.description: Real-time market data (IDX/Global stocks, Crypto, Forex, Commodities), candlestick chart, EMA/RSI/MACD/Bollinger indicators, crypto orderbook, and SQLite trade journal.
plugins.description_id: Dasbor trading dengan data pasar nyata (Saham IDX/Global, Crypto, Forex, Komoditas), grafik candlestick, indikator EMA/RSI/MACD/Bollinger, orderbook, dan jurnal trading SQLite.
plugins.description_cn: 交易分析仪表盘：支持真实行情数据（股票/加密货币/外汇/大宗商品）、K线图、EMA/RSI/MACD/布林带指标、盘口深度与 SQLite 交易日志。
